burnt_sugar.name: The Smell of Burnt Sugar
burnt_sugar.description: Mara burned the first batch and laughed. You kept the laugh.

steady_hand.name: Iven's Steady Hand
steady_hand.description: He does not miss. More importantly, he does not hurry.

backwards_bell.name: The Bell That Rings Backwards
backwards_bell.description: A note played in reverse. The dark answers a beat too late.

ash_lung.name: Ash in the Lungs
ash_lung.description: You learn to breathe where the air has learned to burn.

iven_mark.name: A Mark at Fifty Paces
iven_mark.description: Iven's signal, scratched into a beam. He trusts you to look up.

counterweight.name: The Counterweight
counterweight.description: The foundry taught you where to stand when the floor begins to fall.

ninth_step.name: The Ninth Step
ninth_step.description: There is a stair in the Spire that only appears when you stop counting.
ninth_step.effect: +1 attack and +1 speed to the party.

quiet_room.name: A Room With No Bell
quiet_room.description: For one hour, the city was allowed to be ordinary.

cracked_brass.name: Cracked Brass
cracked_brass.description: The flaw is not the end of the Bell. It is the part that remembers.
cracked_brass.effect: +5 max HP and +1 attack to the party.

watch_whistle.name: A Watchman's Whistle
watch_whistle.description: One short note, two streets away. The Watch always comes too late.

second_hand.name: The Second Hand
second_hand.description: You learn to read the Hound's pause before it lunges.

elias_ledger.name: Elias's Ledger
elias_ledger.description: Every debt in Ember Row, written in a steady hand. He never charged interest.

hounds_patience.name: The Hound's Patience
hounds_patience.description: It does not bark. It waits until you have somewhere to be.
hounds_patience.effect: +1 defense and +1 speed to the party.

gate_left_open.name: A Gate Left Open
gate_left_open.description: Someone in the Watch looked away. You never learned who.

the_debt.name: The Debt
the_debt.description: What you owe the living is heavier than any bell.

ash_on_the_gate.name: Ash on the Gate
ash_on_the_gate.description: The checkpoint burned before dawn. The Watch blamed the wind.

second_bolt.name: Iven's Second Bolt
second_bolt.description: He keeps one in reserve. Now he keeps it for you.

last_lamp.name: The Last Lamp
last_lamp.description: A small light in the ash. Enough to see the next step, not the whole road.

chainbreaker.name: Chainbreaker
chainbreaker.description: Mara's swing, remembered in the wrists and the shoulders.

iron_lung.name: Iron Lung
iron_lung.description: The Bellows teaches you to breathe where the air is a debt.

counterweight_heart.name: A Counterweight Heart
counterweight_heart.description: Something heavy and patient, keeping you upright when the floor gives.

choir_note.name: One Note of the Choir
choir_note.description: You keep a single note. It does not belong to them anymore.

ash_witness.name: The Witness in the Ash
ash_witness.description: The Ashwright called you a witness. You decide what that means.

the_bellows.name: The Bellows
the_bellows.description: Draw in. Hold. Give the fire somewhere to go.
the_bellows.effect: +5 max HP and +1 attack to the party.

refused_offer.name: The Word No
refused_offer.description: Small enough for the Bell to take. Large enough to keep.

deep_air.name: Deep Air
deep_air.description: The lower you go, the older the air. You learn to move through it.
deep_air.effect: +1 defense and +1 speed to the party.

third_shift.name: The Third Shift
third_shift.description: The foundry never sleeps. Neither do you, not anymore.
third_shift.effect: +1 attack and +1 speed to the party.

memory_rose.name: A Rose From the Memory Garden
memory_rose.description: It has no scent. It remembers having one.

oria_blessing.name: Oria's Blessing
oria_blessing.description: A hand on the brow, a name spoken correctly.

garden_hush.name: The Garden's Hush
garden_hush.description: The quiet between one name and the next.

saint_gear.name: A Saint's Gear
saint_gear.description: It turns backward when you are not looking.

wren_song.name: The Wren's Song
wren_song.description: Four notes, repeated. You have heard them before the first day.

name_kept.name: A Name Kept
name_kept.description: The Bell cannot take what you refuse to let it hear.

clockwork_heart.name: Clockwork Heart
clockwork_heart.description: A small brass thing that keeps time even when you do not.
clockwork_heart.effect: +1 defense and +5 max HP to the party.

procession_step.name: The Procession Step
procession_step.description: A measured pace that outlasts panic.
procession_step.effect: +1 attack and +1 speed to the party.

first_wren.name: The First Wren
first_wren.description: A girl on a roof, counting bells. She gets to nine before you do.

wren_chalk.name: Wren's Chalk
wren_chalk.description: Nine names on a slate, rewritten every morning.

house_key.name: The House Key
house_key.description: A small iron key. Wren does not explain who else has one.

first_crack.name: The First Crack
first_crack.description: You know where the Bell is weakest. You aim there.

toma_laugh.name: Toma's Laugh
toma_laugh.description: It arrives at the worst possible moment and makes the room survivable.

hollow_mirror.name: The Hollow Mirror
hollow_mirror.description: You have fought yourself. You know which half flinches.

ninth_memory.name: The Ninth Memory
ninth_memory.description: Something the Bell has tried eight times to take.
ninth_memory.effect: +5 max HP and +1 max Resolve to the party.

quiet_step.name: A Step in the Quiet
quiet_step.description: The Quiet is loud. You learn to move between its words.
quiet_step.effect: +1 defense and +1 speed to the party.

bellkeeper_oath.name: The Bellkeeper's Oath
bellkeeper_oath.description: Not to keep the Bell. To keep the people under it.

empty_house.name: The Empty House
empty_house.description: A door left unlocked for whoever remembers to come back.
empty_house.effect: +1 attack and +5 max HP to the party.

alliance_badge.name: A Watch Alliance Badge
alliance_badge.description: Sera's sigil, still warm from her hand. It buys one gate.

rebel_map.name: The Rebel Map
rebel_map.description: Every locked gate in Aurel, with the ones that are not locked circled twice.

hollow_ward.name: A Hollow Ward
hollow_ward.description: A chalk mark over the heart. The Quiet has to look twice.

sera_sigil.name: Sera's Sigil
sera_sigil.description: One order, written in her hand. You have not decided how to use it.

watch_pike.name: The Watch Pike
watch_pike.description: Long, plain, and honest about its purpose.

choir_iron.name: Iron in the Throat
choir_iron.description: The Iron Choir's note, still lodged where you swallowed it.

saved_bond.name: The Hand You Reached
saved_bond.description: One friend, pulled back from the Quiet. The other still waiting.

coup_memory.name: The Day the Gates Closed
coup_memory.description: You remember which side of the barricade you chose.
coup_memory.effect: +5 max HP and +1 max Resolve to the party.

district_key.name: A District Key
district_key.description: The Watch changed the locks. Someone changed them back.
district_key.effect: +1 defense and +1 speed to the party.

vey_mercy.name: Vey's Mercy
vey_mercy.description: One quiet day, offered without a price you could see.

sanctuary_key.name: The Sanctuary Key
sanctuary_key.description: A door that does not exist on any map of Aurel.

quiet_bell.name: The Bell That Cannot Be Heard
quiet_bell.description: You carry the shape of a silence.

ash_crown.name: The Ash Crown
ash_crown.description: A Saint's authority, reduced to a handful of warm cinders.

saint_pyre.name: The Saint's Pyre
saint_pyre.description: A fire that remembers what it was built to burn.

memory_ash.name: Memory Ash
memory_ash.description: Everything the sanctuary could not keep, pressed into a grey powder.

mercy_kept.name: The Mercy You Kept
mercy_kept.description: A day without a Bell. You remember choosing it.

pyre_oath.name: The Pyre Oath
pyre_oath.description: If the city must burn, let it burn remembering why.
pyre_oath.effect: +1 attack and +5 max HP to the party.

no_bell_room.name: A Room With No Bell
no_bell_room.description: You know where the quiet is now. You can go back.
no_bell_room.effect: +1 defense and +1 max Resolve to the party.

spire_step.name: The Spire Step
spire_step.description: One stair at a time. The city is counting on your knees.

ninth_key.name: The Ninth Key
ninth_key.description: A key with no door. It still fits the Bell.

district_memory.name: A District's Memory
district_memory.description: One part of Aurel, carried up the stair in your hands.

unbound_gear.name: An Unbound Gear
unbound_gear.description: Still turning, even with nothing left to turn.
unbound_gear.effect: +1 attack and +1 defense to the party.

clockwork_skin.name: Clockwork Skin
clockwork_skin.description: It does not make you invulnerable. It makes you harder to stop.

ascent_breath.name: The Ascent Breath
ascent_breath.description: The stair teaches you where to put your weight.

final_bell.name: The Final Bell
final_bell.description: One strike, held in the wrist for the ninth day.

last_quarter.name: The Last Quarter
last_quarter.description: A quarter hour that belongs to no one but the four of you.
last_quarter.effect: +5 max HP and +1 max Resolve to the party.

day_eight.name: The Eighth Day
day_eight.description: Almost. The word has never been so heavy.
day_eight.effect: +1 attack and +1 speed to the party.

last_bell.name: The Last Bell
last_bell.description: One strike left in the wrist. Make it count.

ninth_morning.name: The Ninth Morning
ninth_morning.description: A morning without a Bell. You were there for it.

quiet_name.name: A Name for the Quiet
quiet_name.description: Not a monster. A woman who wanted one more day.

city_memory.name: The City's Memory
city_memory.description: Every street, every name, every ordinary Tuesday.

final_choice.name: The Final Choice
final_choice.description: Whatever happens next, you choose it.
final_choice.effect: +1 attack and +1 speed to the party.

hidden_bell.name: The Hidden Bell
hidden_bell.description: Small enough to hold. It remembers the city before the loop.
hidden_bell.effect: +5 max HP and +1 max Resolve to the party.

all_bonds.name: Six Hands
all_bonds.description: Everyone who stayed. Everyone who came back.
all_bonds.effect: +1 defense and +1 max Resolve to the party.

last_night.name: The Last Night
last_night.description: The dark before the ninth day, shared.
last_night.effect: +1 attack and +5 max HP to the party.

ninth_day.name: The Ninth Day
ninth_day.description: The day after the loop. The one you made.
